title: Mapomo common definitions
description: Shared building blocks referenced by every other Mapomo schema. Contains no top-level object of its own.

id.description: Stable identifier, unique within its type and country. Lowercase, URL safe.

countryCode.description: ISO 3166-1 alpha-2, uppercase. The only place a real jurisdiction is named in Mapomo documents.

money.description: A monetary amount. Always carries its currency; never a bare number. Amounts are decimal strings to avoid binary floating point error in financial aggregation.

amount.description: Decimal amount as a string, in the major unit of the currency.

asOf.description: Date the amount is expressed in. Required when a conversion or a deflator was applied, so the figure stays reproducible.

moneyInterval.description: An estimated amount with an uncertainty interval. Mapomo never publishes a point estimate without one.

intervalType.description: How the interval is to be read. 'range' means plausible bounds with no probabilistic claim.

intervalLevel.description: Probability mass covered, for credible or confidence intervals. 0.9 means a 90 percent interval.

timeWindow.description: A closed or open time window. Observations are rarely instantaneous and pretending otherwise loses information.

precision.description: Granularity actually known, as opposed to the granularity the timestamp format can express.

place.description: Where something was observed. Coordinates are optional and deliberately coarse by default: precise coordinates plus a timestamp can identify the field observer who collected the record.

admin1.description: First-level administrative division code or name, as used in the country configuration.

precisionMeters.description: Radius within which the true location lies. Values below 100 require a documented reason, since they can expose a collector.

quantity.description: A counted quantity with its unit and its own uncertainty. A crowd of 'about 4000' is not the number 4000.

estimationBasis.description: How this number was arrived at. Drives how much the uncertainty propagates downstream.

schemaVersion.description: Version of the Mapomo schema set this document conforms to.

actorRef.description: A reference to an entity in the registry. Never an inline real name: documents carry identifiers, and identifiers resolve through the country's entity registry.

role.description: Relationship of this entity to the record, not its nature. Nature lives on the entity itself.
